title: Kissed Fluffy Spanish Rice Paella
description: A briny, fluffy, and festive Spanish dish featuring heavy cream and temper, made with ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients and cooked in a lotus-leaf-wrap vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the uncooked rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the water, heavy cream, sea salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and fluffy.
Stir the rice gently with a fork to separate the grains.
Spoon the rice mixture onto the center of each lotus leaf wrap.
Fold the lotus leaf wraps to form a square package and serve immediately.
